title: Winter health camp series opens for registration
summary: Free check-ups, eye tests and medicines across five blocks this winter.
content: Sangharsh Samajik Sanstha will run a series of free health camps over the winter months, with general physicians, eye specialists and women's health volunteers on site.
Registration is open to everyone. Please bring any earlier medical papers you have. Volunteers are welcome to help with registration, translation and crowd support.

title: Annual volunteer and supporters' meet
summary: A day to share results, accounts and plans for the year ahead.
content: Each year the Sanstha opens its books and its plans to volunteers, donors and neighbours.
This year's meet will include programme reports, a public question hour with Janak Adhikari and recognition for long-serving volunteers.

title: 120 students receive scholarships this autumn
summary: New scholarships will help first-generation learners continue into secondary school.
content: This autumn, 120 students received scholarships covering fees, books and transport. Most are the first in their families to reach this stage of school.
Janak Adhikari told families that the aim is simple: no child should leave school because of cost.

title: Three new community water points opened
summary: Residents will manage and maintain the new water points themselves.
content: Three villages now have safe, shared water points built with local labour and managed by village committees.
Each committee has been trained in upkeep and simple record-keeping so the points keep running for years.

title: Women's enterprise fair draws record crowds
summary: Shakti group members sold crafts, food and tailoring to hundreds of visitors.
content: More than forty women-run businesses took part in this year's enterprise fair, many for the first time.
Several participants have since received bulk orders and are looking to expand.
